# Cognitive Biases

> An educational mobile app and public reference for recognizing cognitive biases, understanding how they influence judgment, and trying practical countermeasures.

- Canonical website: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/
- Bias library: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/explore/
- Data source: /data/biases.json in the public repository.
- Scope: definitions, plain-language examples, and practical reflection prompts. This is educational information, not medical, legal, financial, or mental-health advice.
- Publisher contact: metalhatscats@gmail.com
